description.en: The ID of the lightweight database instance.

description.zh:
查询错误日志截止时间。按照[ISO 8601](~~25696~~)标准表示，并使用UTC+0时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ。截止时间需大于起始时间。

> +8小时后是控制台上显示的到期时间。
description.en:
The end of the time range to query. The time must be in UTC and formatted as `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ` according to the [ISO 8601](~~25696~~) standard. This value must be later than the start time.

> The time displayed in the console is 8 hours ahead of the specified UTC time.
The number of error logs to return per page.

description.zh:
指定的轻量数据库实例所属的地域ID。

您可以调用[ListRegions](~~189315~~)查看支持的阿里云地域列表。
description.en:
The ID of the region where the lightweight database instance resides.

You can call the [ListRegions](~~189315~~) operation to query the latest list of Alibaba Cloud regions.

description.zh:
查询错误日志起始时间。按照[ISO 8601](~~25696~~)标准表示，并使用UTC+0时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ。

> +8小时后是控制台上显示的到期时间。
description.en:
The start of the time range to query. The time must be in UTC and formatted as `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ` according to the [ISO 8601](~~25696~~) standard.

> The time displayed in the console is 8 hours ahead of the specified UTC time.

descriptions.zh: 您可以调用此接口，查询数据库的错误日志，帮助您定位问题。
descriptions.en: Use this operation to query the error logs of a lightweight database instance to identify and troubleshoot issues.
